answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks clone farms. A newcomer joins only when a sponsor stakes 20 units and vouches for them, the rank recorded on the terrace ledger. A sponsor who vouches for a clone loses the stake, and standing decays each epoch. Honest work finds a haven: 1,000 clones need 1,000 sponsors and lose 20,000 units for a 50-unit reward, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its share. A plume marks repeat sponsors.
